description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named SearchInvoke, demonstrating search functionalities such as invoking the search UI, handling menu options related to search, and managing search history within an Android application.

classes.name: SearchInvoke
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating search integration including search invocation, menu handling, and search history management.
